summary: Aegon Ltd. filed a 6-K reporting a voting undertaking with its largest shareholder, Vereniging Aegon (18.4% voting rights), to support its proposed redomiciliation from Bermuda to Delaware. The agreement covers voting in favor of the redomiciliation and the 2027 Omnibus Incentive Plan at an EGM expected October 8, 2026. A Form F-4 proxy statement/prospectus will be filed. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearance of the cross-border continuation.
